title: feat(nnlock): incoming-lock letters: reverse and face hold on none
science: Named-sign readout of earliest incoming locks at the four x-probes: locks(A)={+-e2,+-e3}, locks(B)={+e1,+e2,+e3}, locks(C)=locks(D)={+e1}; 12 earliest combinations. Reverse and face are both `none` because B and D never carry a minus-signed lock, with genuine mutation controls showing that dropping the L(B)=- conjunct gives `some` (6/12) and dropping L(D)=- gives `hold-on-all`.
